metadata.description: PR Jangler — autonomous GitHub PR backlog workflow as a BMad module. Install the full pack, the lightweight hub skill, or copy individual phase skills à la carte.

plugins.name: pr-jangler
plugins.description: Full pack: cron heartbeat, discovery, triage, verification, review, overlap detection, fix-planning, adversarial validation, fix-implementation, decision, daily reporting, and the hub orientation skill.

plugins.name: pr-jangler-hub
plugins.description: Hub skill only — routing knowledge and operating principles for PR Jangler without the phase scripts. Use to orient an agent on the workflow, then install individual phase skills as needed.
